A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT BE WONDERING

Good questions.
Honest answers.

01Do I need experience to start?+

Just curiosity and a little time. Every path starts with the basics, then gives you a useful challenge. You’ll have a mentor and a small team alongside you.

02What does a typical week look like?+

Plan for 4–6 hours of project work, one small-team check-in, and practical feedback from your mentor. The work fits around your life, with space to learn at your own pace.

03Will I have something for my portfolio?+

That’s the idea. You’ll finish with a project, a clear account of how you approached it, and feedback that helps you explain what you learned.

04Can I try a path before committing?+

Explore any path above to see its sample brief and skills. This is a fictional landing-page template: the signup below creates a local preview, with no payment or enrollment.
